scenes.say: Whole beans or ground? One fades faster.
Grinding cuts each bean into tiny pieces. Far more surface meets the air. Oxygen is what stales coffee.
Beans stay fresh longer. Ground coffee fades sooner.
Moh-ka and espresso want different grinds. With beans, you choose.
Stuck with ground? Buy small bags. Finish them soon.
Beans keep longer. Ground saves time. Save this for your next bag.
